source: Guardrails for money that moves inside a dynamic: allowances, tributes, financial submission, a shared purse. Drawn from consent practice in the community: a cap, a review, a way out, and a floor nobody goes below.
confidenceNote: These are the app's checks, not anyone's rules for your relationship. A check that fails is a conversation to have, not a verdict.

checks.label: The giver stays above their own floor
checks.why: After their share of the house and what they give, the giver can still cover their own lean month. Money play that eats rent is not play.

checks.label: There is a cap
checks.why: A monthly ceiling, agreed in advance, that no scene raises.

checks.label: There is a review date
checks.why: A day both of you look at the numbers with the scene off.

checks.label: There is a safeword for money
checks.why: One word ends the arrangement, no explanation owed, no penalty.

checks.label: The giver's own fund is not drained
checks.why: What they give comes from what is left after their fund set-aside, never from the fund.

splitRules.label: In proportion to income
splitRules.hint: Whoever earns more pays more, in the same ratio.
